Your own library of films and series, at home

Maktaba runs on a computer or a NAS in your home. It keeps your films, series and recordings in order, makes subtitles for them, and plays them on your phone, your computer and your TV.

Choose your install guide Download the apps
  • One person sets it upEveryone at home watches, each with their own sign-in.
  • It updates itselfNew versions install in the quiet hours you choose.
  • Your library stays yoursYour films stay at home. Watching while you’re away is up to you.

  • Install on a NAS or a computer

    Step-by-step guides for Synology, TrueNAS, Unraid, QNAP, UGREEN and any machine with Docker. Most take about 15 minutes.

Maktaba

Maktaba keeps a household’s films and series on its own computer and plays them on every screen at home. Free and open source, under the MIT licence.
